name: Prototype mineral-row base costs without abilities
description: Synthetic component records; cost bytes 1..32, triad 0..2, missile flag, signed offense -1..127, weapon mode 0..14 and reactor 1..4. Original component table slots chassis0..8/weapon0..25/armor0..13. Ability mask is fixed zero. Output is mineral rows, not final minerals: excludes faction/map factors, prototype surcharges, unit availability/design validation, production and UI. Matrices and boundary samples do not exhaust every valid input. No original rules database or code is embedded.
